title: Daya Poornuda – Nissi John Telugu Christian Lyrics
english: Sthuthi simhaasana seenuda kruthagnatha sthuthulu neekenayya
Alalavale neevu naa thoduvai addhariki cherchaavu naa saayamai
Nannu veekshinchu dayaalluda nannu rakshinchu dayaamayuda
2. Krupa vathsaramunu osagithivi daya kireetamunu ichithivi
Nannu balaparachu dayaalluda nannu sthiraparachu dayaamayuda
3. Naa sthuthula simhaasanamupai aaseenudavaina naa Yesayya
Ninnu sthuthiyinchi bhajiyinchi aaraadhinchedhanu naa Yesayya
Ninnu paadedha dayaalluda ninne pogadedha dayaamayuda
translation: O Merciful One, O Compassionate One, You are full of mercy for my life.
O One seated on the throne of praise, my songs of gratitude are for You alone.
1. When I was struggling and in a miserable state without any support,
You were with me like waves and, as my help, You brought me to the shore.
O Compassionate One who watches over me, O Merciful One who saves me.
2. You gave me a year of grace and crowned me with mercy.
You made me climb unreachable peaks and filled me with blessings.
O Compassionate One who strengthens me, O Merciful One who establishes me.
3. O my Jesus, who is seated upon the throne of my praises,
I will praise, worship, and adore You, my Jesus.
I will sing to You, O Compassionate One; I will extol You, O Merciful One.
intro: Daya Poornuda is the latest Telugu Christian song written & tuned by Ambati Cherubim, sung by Ambati Cherubim featuring Nissi John and music composed by Raymond Kingston, produced by Ambati Fimmy. This song was released on April 19, 2026, through Nissi Ministries YouTube Channel.
